title: Computing higher limits over the fusion orbit category via amalgams
summary: We study higher limits over the centric orbit category of a fusion system realized by an amalgamated product. In so doing we provide a novel technique for studying the Diaz-Park sharpness conjecture and prove it (in the case of the cohomology Mackey functors) for all the Clelland-Parker and Parker-Stroth fusion systems. This complements previous work from Henke, Libmand and Lynd.
